posts.title: Week #13
posts.description: The cold strikes! This one's going to be the shortest one yet. It was a rough week as most of it was spent being sick. Thankfully, it happened right now and not during finals week. Regardless, I was able to complete all my projects on time. I also happened to visit our college's art gallery, which had some interesting pieces.
